integration_notes: API 1.0 old set_input validation/normalization and no-argument factories remain compatible. New set_composition/input_text preserve original Unicode/case/digits/symbols. Candidate IDs and raw-coordinate edit rules remain revision-bound.

PlatformSession.convert(composition,cursor) now uses mixed composition and returns an optional literal_digits flag. Preserve incoming case/digits/symbols and use that flag to distinguish digit insertion from numeric candidate selection; explicit select always selects. Space/Return retain selection/literal semantics; input_text always inserts.

Core partial selection stays in preedit; platform port still commits the accepted prefix immediately and returns the original remaining text with cursor=0. Integration must test actual application text, editing, focus and stale IDs.

Set purpose/private/hints before forwarding input. Context switches clear composition/caches and use the public model. Password key bypass is still owned by platform; core additionally rejects personal ranking/learning.

Use explicit product user_data_dir=<product-data-dir>/learning. Lexicon CLI --data-dir must target exactly this directory. Preserve it during upgrades/uninstalls; after external import/remove use reload_lexicon as needed.

Only ziranma double pinyin is declared. All named fuzzy/correction switches are preserved. Measurements enable correction; all_features also enables every fuzzy rule and learning. Record actual product settings when integrating.

Mixed selection learns only canonical Chinese fragments, never raw email/URL/English/numeric tokens. Learning off stops new records but retains ranking of existing words. New sessions default to learning=false.
Complete corpus and all 338 historical slow samples are retained. Raw data and standalone profiling scripts live under checks/mixed-revision and tools; no test answers were imported into lexicons.
Do not substitute the 12 short mixed behavior cases for the 200-case full-corpus timing/quality denominators. Read composition_corpus profiles for the new product API.

unresolved.detail: Same 169 solved cases: mean selection actions 1.4793 -> 1.6036; P95/P99 6/8 -> 7/11. Literal choices and fragment recomputation increase some costs.
All-feature composition corpus P95 32.3663 ms meets 50 ms; 66 calls exceed 50 ms, max 75.1492 ms. Historical slow cohort P95 54.882 ms, gap 4.8820 ms; 47/338 still over 50 ms.

New input API exact top1/top5 129/152 out of 200, 28 unsolved by fixed policy; mixed 1/25 exact top1 and 2/25 solvable. Missing symbols/case are not reconstructed; uninterrupted lowercase boundaries remain ambiguous.

Full sentence N-best stays full-length; local phrase enumeration has a 24-codepoint window, repairs decode at most 4 of the general edit hypotheses, alternatives use 2 first-syllable branches; no hard cancellation inside native calls. Long partial phrases may be absent.
Process-local candidate computation, no GUI/IPC timing. Cold runs do not flush OS page cache. Personal benchmark uses 128 entries; no large-store/Windows 11 comparison.
Only canonical, validated Chinese fragments are learned. Native personal phrases below 16 characters combine; 16-character phrases are exact-only; longer or ambiguous readings do not persist.
